saltspur_scout: Scout Vel Ashgrave. This is Saltspur Landing, the Horde's shore camp on the east coast of Arathi. There are pirate crews on three of the islands east of us. They are not raiding ships - they have dug in and posted watches, which means they are guarding something out there. I want to know what.
saltspur_bosun: Bosun Kaz Tidewright. Orgrimmar sent four boats to this coast and no officer, so I run the Landing. This is the Landing Yard. The stores are north of us and the shipwright's beach is south. We need hulls, and every hull on this coast is on the rocks.
saltspur_shipwright: Oona Keelsplice, shipwright. This is my beach, the south end of Saltspur Landing. There are wrecks all along the Wrackline Shore east of here, and some of them can be floated again. Give me timber, fittings and a low tide, and I will give the Landing boats.
